name: Product card
what: A product from your catalogue: its picture on a card rises and settles, its name comes up word by word, what it is fades in, the price pops in, a button with your website slides in and pulses once, your logo fades into the card's corner. Upright the picture sits on top; wide, left of the words. Over a video, the words sit on a card of their own.
origin: MotionLab's own build for My Brand's product motion (0.6.0, 2026-10-25), in the Editorial warm look
motion: f0-f12 the card rises 70 px and scales 0.9 -> 1 (decelerating); f8-f22 the name word by word, each 2 f after the one before, rising half its size; f14-f24 what it is fades up; f18-f28 the price pops 1.35 -> 1 with an overshoot; f24-f34 the button slides 40 px in; f30-f40 the logo fades in; f64-f74 the button pulses once; then it holds
